definition: The Book of Malachi, the last book of the Christian Old Testament, which promises that Elijah will be sent before the day of the Lord and that the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings. Dick equated Malachi's returning Spirit of Elijah with the Christian Holy Spirit, and quotes the healing verse in the Exegesis and in VALIS.
card_description: The last Old Testament prophet, whose promise of Elijah's return Dick used to name what possessed him.
